Formosa Advanced Technologies.why: Memory back-end OEM: packages and tests DRAM ICs and assembles memory modules, mainly for Nanya Technology (71% of 2025 net sales); AI-driven DRAM tightness (HBM/DDR5 crowding out DDR4) is lifting its packaging/test volumes, OEM prices and capex (TSV, bumping, chip stacking at its new Factory 5).
Formosa Advanced Technologies.evidence: Formosa Advanced Technologies 2025 annual report: customers above 10% of sales - Nanya Technology (related party) NT$7,042,085 thousand, 71% of 2025 net sales (76% in 2024, 77% in Q1 2026); the company provides one-stop chip probing, assembly, final test and module services.

players.product: DRAM IC packaging and testing (wafer probe, assembly, final test) and DRAM memory module (DIMM) assembly - turn-key memory back-end OEM services

quarterly_data.quarter: Formosa Advanced Technologies IR presentation: Q2 2026 results investor conference (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D plan: wafer bump and RDL - equipment relocation and setup in Q2 2026, installation and initial process trials in Q3, pilot-run validation in Q4, targeting 20K+ bumps/die for full-flow wafer bump production and extending from memory FCCSP to high-pin-count ASIC and FCBGA logic packaging. 3D TSV, BVR and 2-layer chip stacking successfully developed, product validation expected in Q4; 4-layer chip stacking trials planned for Q2 next year; products expected for high-capacity, high-speed DDR5 R-DIMM server modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Formosa Advanced Technologies IR presentation: Q2 2026 results investor conference (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Business overview: management says the rapid expansion of AI applications is changing the memory supply-demand structure, with demand much exceeding supply, creating a positive cycle for IC assembly and test OEM; short-term product-portfolio adjustment, long-term capacity expansion. The advanced assembly process equipment at Factory #5 was delivered and installed in Q3 2026, with machine verification and product certification expected in Q4

quarterly_data.quarter: Formosa Advanced Technologies IR presentation: Q2 2026 results investor conference (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Market outlook (company): HBM and RDIMM demand from AI and general servers has squeezed the supply of consumer memory; rising DRAM IC prices slowed end-consumer spot module demand while server and industrial module demand stays stable; the supply-demand imbalance is driving memory prices up and prompting Taiwanese makers to raise output and expand capacity, which will also boost assembly and test OEM demand
